thread:
mika: Quick sync — we need a clear checklist for ISV adapter certification (LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors + gateway + orchestration). Target: marketplace pub + HW partner bundle by 2025-10-15. Who owns sections?

sam: I can own LangChain adapter tests. Will need sample repo, smoke tests, and a minimal eval set.

lee: I'll take gateway adapter (auth + signing). Need to confirm our gateway SDK creds for SI partners and the expected auth flows (api-key, oauth, broker).

aisha: DevEx will own docs + quickstart + examples. Can we standardize a manifest and a small `make smoke-test`?

mika: Draft manifest idea below — keep it minimal and extensible: ```yaml
name: my-adapter
version: 0.1.0
compatibility: [langchain, llamaindex]
endpoints:
  - path: /invoke
    method: POST
  - path: /health
    method: GET
auth:
  type: oauth2
extensions:
  - name: auth-broker
    optional: true
capabilities: [streaming, batch-rerank]
```

sam: Perf targets? For hardware partners we should surface quantization knobs and a perf matrix (latency @ seq_len 512, throughput @ batch 8). Also what reg datasets for quality?

lee: Agree. Add compatibility rows for GPU families (A100/H100/T4), quant levels (fp16/8bit/4bit), and recommended batch sizes. I'll own the perf matrix.

ryan: Marketplace packaging requires SBOM, license info, privacy statement, and security attestation. Legal/procurement will want a contact and timeline.

aisha: We'll provide a docs template and quickstart. Suggest we include a minimal CI job that runs the adapter smoke test in our infra: `ci/adapter-smoke.sh` -> hits /health and runs a single sample generation.

jen-bot: CI update: adapter-ci/PR-482 passed smoke and lint ✅ (flake rate 0.19%, logs at https://ci.redwood/adapter/482).

mika: Action items (assign & due dates): sam — langchain tests + repo template (due 2025-09-24); lee — gateway adapter + perf matrix (due 2025-09-30); aisha — docs + quickstart + test prompts (due 2025-10-02); ryan — marketplace packaging checklist & legal contact (due 2025-10-05). I'll assemble partner runbook and propose announcement windows.

sam: noted. I'll scaffold the template repo today and include a sample eval set and a `tests/smoke.yaml`. Posting link when ready.

aisha: Please add 1-2 targeted prompts per adapter for regen quality checks (e.g., summarization + factual QA). DevEx will wire these into the regression job.

lee: Flagging potential blocker — some SI partners use a custom auth broker that mutates headers. We should expose a shim hook in the manifest so adapters can opt-in. @sam heads-up.

sam: will add an `auth.broker_hook` extension point to the manifest and a small example in the template.

mika: Good. Also confirm whether HW partners expect a prebuilt container or an infra spec. For marketplace + HW bundles we should offer both: container image + deployment descriptor.

ryan: I'll coordinate packaging expectations with the partner ops lead and confirm SBOM tooling.

aisha: Ok — next step: short cross-functional standup tomorrow 10:30 PT to align on blocking items and announce PR links. :party-parrot:

mika: Thanks team — big win if we get this certified cleanly before partner roadmap window.
